sloka: ऋक्षाणां भीमवेगानां धूम्रः शत्रुनिबर्हणः ।वृतः कोट्या महावीर्यस्तस्थो रामस्य पार्श्वतः ।। ६.४२.२९ ।।।।
transliteration: ṛkṣāṇāṁ bhīmavegānāṁ dhūmraḥ śatrunibarhaṇaḥ ।vṛtaḥ koṭyā mahāvīryastastho rāmasya pārśvataḥ ।। 6.42.29 ।।।।

translations.english: Accompanied by a crore of Bears of redoubtable fury, Dhumra (brother of Jambavan), an exterminator of foes endowed with extraordinary valour stood by Rama's side.
